GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex Team Lee) Jumped ok went back Soon After settled second last Two Wide 9 Lengths (700m), cornered last, no run on (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME, Lugging Bit FIRST TIME) # did nothing

Jumped okay & Went Forward to 3 Wide Lead by 0.75 Lengths , Headed 950m, in Two Wide 900m, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # worked a bit early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Pushed fwd to lead on rail by 2 Lengths early . Held lead on inside midrace until 4L clear @ 600m. Pushed to quicken @ 400m & 4L clear on home turn. Extended margin on inside in straight. # Led - bolted in.
Jumped okay & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 4 Lengths rail turning, blocked initially on straightening, switched inside leader at 220m and kept coming # just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 200m was obliged to shift in around heels to continue to improve when disappointed for a run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # wide/ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # Had its chances
Jumped Ok drifted back 5-6l off, under whip turn, Straightened Up 3l off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 900m was steadied from the heels of a runner which shifted in when not fully clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Niggled to recover & raced behind Mid Field on inside (6L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed to quicken on inside (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & chased solidly in last 200m. # Solid effort.

Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 9 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground passing tired runners in straight. First start: Need to see again. (Blindfold FIRST TIME) # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in under pressure down the straight and near the 100m was carried in further by another runner.
